name: mame-cabinet
what: Turns a Debian/Ubuntu/Mint laptop into an arcade cabinet: it boots into a game, ESC opens the game list, the chosen game becomes the default. No desktop, no window manager, no Hydra app on the box.
why_not_hydra: This is not a Hydra service. There is no door, no catalog entry, no dispatch and no karma: the machine has one job and no server. It is an appliance definition so the same box can be built N times.

min.cpu_note: 2 cores is enough for 1979-1985 2D; 3D and outrun-class need more

inputs.roms: ~/mame/roms  (a symlink to another disk is fine; MAME follows it)
inputs.desktop_link: ~/Desktop/ROMs -> ~/mame/roms, so drag-and-drop works without a terminal
inputs.last_game: ~/last_game - written before the game starts, so a power cut does not forget it

steps: romtools.sh --rebuild: verify every zip, keep only the drivers that really start
install the session script + xsessions entry; set lightdm autologin-session=mame-cabinet
reboot and confirm the attract screen, ESC to the list, and that the choice survives a reboot
verify: ~/mame-start.sh --list | wc -l          number of games this box can start
~/romtools.sh --check <driver>          required files and what is missing
xwininfo -root -tree | grep MAME        a fullscreen window at the panel resolution
romtools.sh --rebuild then <ESC>        a set that vanishes from the list was never playable

measured.box: ThinkPad X120e, AMD E-350 2x1.6GHz, HD 6310, 1.5GB RAM, 1366x768

unplayable.arknoid2: one file, NO GOOD DUMP KNOWN - will never be complete
unplayable.digdug2: one file, NO GOOD DUMP KNOWN - will never be complete

measured.note: 100% = the arcade board's own speed. Under ~95% stutters with sound; gyruss 79 and outrun 46 will not be playable on this class of machine.

notes: The session has a crash guard: three starts inside a minute and it execs xfce4-session instead of looping on a black screen. Delete ~/.mame/session-starts to re-arm.
ROM sets are copyright; this definition installs the player, never the games. romtools.sh names exactly which files a set is missing so a download can be checked before it is trusted.
A zip that is a SET rather than a DRIVER (arkanoid_junk) is rejected by name, because mame answers 'Unknown system' and it would look like a broken install.
